name: Icon grid stamp
oneLiner: a glass grid of app tiles (glyph squircle and label) builds in, each with a price chip popping onto its corner; then a big inked rubber stamp (FREE by default) slams down across the grid, the tiles jolt and every price chip is knocked off and falls away
say: when the speaker says a whole stack of paid tools can be had for nothing ("all of these, every one of them, free"): cut in on the tools; the stamp lands on "free". Set stamp to another word (OPEN SOURCE, INCLUDED, DONE) and tone to accent or red to change its meaning
